alternative: 02 Passage / 后界: six-pt continuation after entry, weaker value at actual size

numbering.after_success: Renumber once after movement settles; no rolling-digit animation
numbering.during_attempt: Hold position and number through wait, failure, unknown
numbering.internal: Immutable screenshot and operation identities separate from display numbers
numbering.pointer: Bind image on pointer down; defer reorder while held; suppress continuation of the old double-click on the next row

waiting_feedback: short static underline under number + subtle 8pt contact-edge activity; no blue ring
unknown_feedback: stationary double underline; item and original operation retained; reconcile before retry

capacity.12_at_72: All visible and directly clickable in the specified 900pt scene; fixed 60pt pitch
capacity.90_proportional_scale: 12 tallest images need 884pt before system clearances; with y180 last bottom1029; not recommended
capacity.54: 12 tallest images need572pt; lowest interference but little portrait recognition area
capacity.90_stress_film: 9 second 54/72/90 comparison at 12 portrait images. At 90pt, only 10 are fully visible, 11 partially, 12 outside the viewport. No artificial fit.
